Create a free loyalty account online to become a member and start earning rewards.
Browse products and use the Size Guide link next to the size selector on each product page for fit details.
Use “Available Near You” to see what’s in stock at a specific store.
When you’re ready to buy, place an order and you’ll receive email updates with tracking links so you can follow your parcel.
At checkout, you can apply Barkers Dollars and rewards on the payments page (don’t use the cart coupon field for loyalty coupons).
If you forget your password, use the password reset link to get back into your account.

If you need more help, you can ask to speak to a customer representative agent.

Can you explain the main options in simple terms?

Digital Assistant · AI

Digital Assistant · AI says:

Here are the main options, in straightforward terms:

Shopping options

Click & Collect: Buy online, pick up in a store you choose. Some items are ready in a few hours if they’re already in that store; others take a few days if they must be sent in. You’ll get an email when they’re ready.
Available Near You: Filter the website to only show items your chosen store currently has.

Returns option (in‑store purchases)

Bring items bought in-store back to any of our stores within 30 days (in original condition with proof of purchase) for a refund, exchange, or store credit, depending on eligibility.

Data & cookies options

Necessary cookies: Needed for the website to work and keep your account secure.
Acceptance/notice cookies: Remember that you’ve agreed to our cookie use.
Functionality cookies: Remember things like your login or language so the site feels more personalized.
Tracking & performance cookies: Help us understand how people use the site and test new features.
Targeting & advertising cookies: Let us (and approved partners) show ads more relevant to your interests based on browsing.

Garment care approaches

Use cool or warm washes, avoid high heat and direct sun, and follow the specific care label on each garment to keep items looking good longer.

If you tell us which area you’re most interested in (shopping, returns, privacy/cookies, or garment care), we can focus on just those options in even simpler terms.

Privacy policy
